source: GG research (burn-rate placement for powders not on the Vihtavuori chart)

placements.name: S121
placements.rationale: Extremely fast spherical shot/handgun powder sitting at the fastest end of the pistol band near Bullseye/W231/HP-38-class charts split on exact rank.

placements.name: MS200
placements.rationale: Extremely fast flake shotshell/fast-pistol powder placed beside Red Dot/American Select, essentially co-located with S121 at the very fast end.

placements.name: MP200
placements.rationale: Fast flake pistol/shotshell powder one step slower than S121/MS200, sitting in the Unique/Blue Dot/Herco band.

placements.name: S221
placements.rationale: Medium spherical revolver/pistol powder in the HS-6/Longshot/Blue Dot band, slower than the fast pistol powders and faster than magnum-revolver powders.

placements.name: S265
placements.rationale: Magnum-revolver powder squarely in the standard H110/W296/2400 magnum-handgun class, the slowest of the handgun powders.

placements.name: S321
placements.rationale: Fast rifle ball powder mapped to AA2230/Benchmark/H335/BLC-2 class per Somchem's own table; the stray S321-equals-H4198 claim is too fast and is a known chart error.

placements.name: S335
placements.rationale: Medium extruded rifle powder equal to IMR3031/AA2460/N133 per Hunting Africa table; sits just faster than Varget and is NOT the Varget powder (common S335/S355 confusion).

placements.name: S341
placements.rationale: Medium ball rifle powder in the IMR4895/BLC-2/Varget band; slower than S335 per Somchem's fast-to-slow order, the .308/.30-06 workhorse grade.

placements.name: S355
placements.rationale: The classic community Varget/RL15 equivalent (AR2208), one notch slower than S335; H4350 is a touch too slow for it.

placements.name: S361
placements.rationale: Slow rifle ball powder triangulated between S355 and S365, on the fast edge of the H4350 band (spherical sibling of S365, just faster).

placements.name: S365
placements.rationale: Flagship slow extruded rifle powder equal to IMR4350/H4350/AR2209 per Somchem and Hunting Africa; NOT H4831/RL22 which is S385 territory.

placements.name: S385
placements.rationale: Slowest Somchem powder, equal to IMR4831/H4831/RL22/Norma MRP by burn rate; used in place of H1000/Retumbo locally though technically a hair faster than those.

placements.name: StaBALL Match
placements.rationale: Medium match-rifle ball powder; used for .223/.22-250/6mm/.308 in our data — Varget/RL15 class.

placements.name: StaBALL HD
placements.rationale: Slow high-density magnum ball powder; used for 6.5 PRC/7mm PRC/7mm Rem Mag/Nosler magnums in our data — H1000/Retumbo class.

placements.name: D032-03 (Clean Shot)
placements.rationale: Manufacturer explicitly names W231/HP-38, Titegroup, and Accurate No.2. Titegroup is the spine node at this fast-pistol speed; fastest of the line.

placements.name: D036-07 (Ultimate Pistol)
placements.rationale: Manufacturer: comparable to CFE Pistol / AutoComp, faster than AA No.5, slower than AA No.2. Sits between Unique and HS-6; CFE Pistol is the tightest spine anchor.

placements.name: D036-03 (Auto Pistol)
placements.rationale: Manufacturer names HS-6, Longshot, Accurate No.5. Mid-pistol slot; HS-6 is the closest single spine anchor, Longshot marginally slower.

placements.name: D037-01 (Major Pistol)
placements.rationale: Manufacturer: similar to AA No.7, 2400 and Blue Dot. Magnum-pistol range straddling the 2400/Blue Dot node.

placements.name: D037-02 (Heavy Pistol)
placements.rationale: Manufacturer: same application as 2400, H110, W296; ≈ AA No.9. Slowest pistol powder, anchors at the H110/W296 magnum-pistol node.

placements.name: D063-02 (Blackout)
placements.rationale: Manufacturer states ≈ Accurate 1680, which sits a step slower than H110/Lil'Gun near IMR4227/H4198 on the spine. NOT the H110/Lil'Gun node despite 300 BLK use-case overlap. Straddles slow-pistol / fast-rifle boundary.

placements.name: D060-01 (Buffalo Rifle)
placements.rationale: SW groups it with Accurate 5744 / IMR 4227 for reduced/cast-bullet & straight-wall rifle. Fastest true rifle powder; anchors near IMR4227/H4198. (Some lineup sources list code as S040; retailer/guide data points to the A5744/IMR4227 speed node either way.)

placements.name: D073-01 (Tactical Rifle)
placements.rationale: Manufacturer: superior alternative to H335 and BLC(2). Ball powder in the H335/TAC/CFE223 neighborhood; fast rifle.

placements.name: D073-04 (AR Plus)
placements.rationale: Lovex/distributor data: ≈ Accurate 2230, just faster than Tactical Rifle in the H335/BLC-2 cluster. No manufacturer-page equivalent, hence medium confidence.

placements.name: D073-06 (Match Rifle)
placements.rationale: Manufacturer names Accurate 2520; retailers add CFE223, IMR 4064, RL15. Ball powder one notch faster than Varget — a hair faster than the true Varget analog (Precision Rifle).

placements.name: S062 (Precision Rifle)
placements.rationale: Manufacturer: burn rate and temp sensitivity very similar to Varget — the strongest 1:1 claim in the lineup, and an extruded powder like Varget. This is the true Varget node.

placements.name: S065 (Long Rifle)
placements.rationale: Sources disagree: retailers market it for the H4350 use-case (6.5 CM/.30-06) but SW's own guide and burn-rate charts place S065 between H380 and H414/W760 — i.e. faster than H4350. Best burn-rate anchor is the H414/W760/N550 region (spine: N540/RL17), NOT IMR4350/H4350. Treat H4350 as an application match only.

placements.name: S070 (SW4350)
placements.rationale: Named directly for and marketed as an H4350/IMR 4350 equivalent; medium-magnum use (.30-06, 6.5 CM, .300 Win Mag). Anchors squarely at the H4350/IMR4350 node.

placements.name: S071 (Ultimate Rifle)
placements.rationale: Overbore/magnum powder (≈ Accurate 3100 / IMR 7828). Slowest of the line; anchors in the RL22 / IMR7828 / H1000 slow-magnum region.
